# Cherished Companions

> > Holistic pet services combining positive reinforcement dog training, cat behavior consulting, animal communication, tarot readings, and Reiki energy healing for dogs and cats across Vancouver, Richmond, and virtual distances.

Cherished Companions is a comprehensive pet wellness platform founded by Caitlin Gawa, offering both in-person and virtual services that blend conventional pet training with holistic healing practices, energy work, and spiritual pet bonding. The business serves clients across Canada with specialized programs for puppies, adult dogs, cats, and pet parents seeking deeper connections with their animals.

## Key Topics

- Dog Training
- Cat Behavior Consulting
- Animal Communication
- Tarot Readings
- Reiki Energy Healing
- Positive Reinforcement
- Pet Wellness
- Holistic Pet Care
- Pet Bonding
- Energy Healing
- Pet Spirituality
- Distance Sessions
- Caitlin Gawa
- Vancouver & Richmond Services
- Intuitive Guidance

## Core Services

- [Work With Me - Services Overview](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/work-with-me): Main services page offering dog training, cat behavior, animal communication, and energy healing both in-person and virtually across Richmond and Canada.
- [Dog & Puppy Training](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/dog-puppy-training): In-person dog and puppy training in Vancouver using positive reinforcement and relationship building techniques.
- [First-Time Puppy Parent Training](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/puppy): Specialized first-time puppy parent training program in Vancouver with positive reinforcement methods.
- [Cat Behaviour Consulting](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/cat-behaviour-consulting): Cat behavior consulting combining training, animal communication, and Reiki energy healing.

## Energy Healing & Spiritual Services

- [Tarot Reading For Your Pet](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/tarotreading): Tarot reading service for pet animal communication and intuitive guidance by Caitlin Gawa.
- [Dog & Cat Communication Tarot](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/dogcatcommunicationtarot): Dog & Cat Communication Tarot deck product for pet bonding and animal communication.
- [Reiki Energy Healing for Dogs](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/reikidog): Virtual Reiki energy healing service for dogs to restore physical and emotional well-being.
- [Reiki Energy Healing for Cats](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/reikicat): Virtual Reiki energy healing service for cats to restore physical and emotional well-being.

## Courses & Training Programs

- [Bonded - Holistic Pet Connection Course](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/bonded): Bonded holistic course for building trust and deepening dog and cat connections through energy work.
- [Synergy - Witches & Their Familiars](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/synergy): Self-paced course on pet anxiety, animal communication, and energetic alignment with your pets.
- [Heal Your Relationship With Pet Course](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/heal): Holistic course for healing pet relationships through energy work and pet communication.
- [Pet Bonding & Relationship Building Challenge](https://www.cherishedcompanions.org/bonding): 7-day pet bonding challenge with daily connection and bonding activities for dogs and cats.
